background_story: Cakes was a majestic thoroughbred named after Chaim Weizmann, the first president of Israel. Born on a kibbutz in the rolling hills of the Galilee, Cakes was bred for speed and agility. As a foal, she would often explore the surrounding countryside, discovering hidden streams and secret meadows. As she grew, Cakes became a champion show jumper, clearing fences with ease and precision. Her rider, a young Israeli equestrian, credited Cakes' success to her intelligence, athleticism, and strong work ethic - qualities reminiscent of the esteemed statesman she was named after. Together, they won numerous competitions, earning Cakes a reputation as one of the finest horses in the country.
